text.EN: Keeping busy. Don't distract me.
text.TL: Abala ako. Huwag mo akong gambalain.

text.EN: I've got work to do. Keep moving.
text.TL: May trabaho pa ako. Magpatuloy ka na.

text.EN: Hands are full right now. Leave me to it.
text.TL: Marami akong ginagawa ngayon. Hayaan mo muna ako.

text.EN: Occupied. Don't crowd my workspace.
text.TL: May ginagawa ako. Huwag kang humarang dito.

text.EN: Too much to do to stand around chatting.
text.TL: Masyadong maraming gagawin para tumambay at makipag-usap.

text.EN: I'm busy with survival. You should be too.
text.TL: Abala ako sa pagpapatuloy. Dapat ikaw rin.

text.EN: Focusing on my duties. Step back.
text.TL: Nakatutok ako sa tungkulin ko. Umatras ka.

text.EN: Work doesn't stop because you want to talk.
text.TL: Hindi hihinto ang trabaho dahil lang gusto mong makipag-usap.

text.EN: Busy here. Come back when I'm done.
text.TL: Abala ako rito. Bumalik ka kapag tapos na ako.

text.EN: Got critical tasks to finish. Don't get in the way.
text.TL: May mahalagang gawain akong tatapusin. Huwag kang humarang.

text.EN: I'm keeping busy and trying to stay useful.
text.TL: Abala ako at sinusubukan kong maging kapaki-pakinabang.

text.EN: Just working through my checklist for the day.
text.TL: Inaayos ko lang ang mga kailangan kong gawin ngayong araw.

text.EN: Plenty of chores to keep my mind off the dead.
text.TL: Maraming gawain para hindi maisip ang mga patay.

text.EN: Taking care of camp business. Always something to fix.
text.TL: Inaasikaso ang mga kailangan sa kampo. Laging may aayusin.

text.EN: Putting in work so we all stay safe.
text.TL: Nagtatrabaho para manatiling ligtas tayong lahat.

text.EN: Staying occupied. It helps pass the hours.
text.TL: Pinananatiling abala ang sarili. Nakatutulong magpalipas ng oras.

text.EN: Tending to tasks. What about you?
text.TL: Gumagawa ng mga gawain. Kumusta naman ikaw?

text.EN: Got a few projects on my plate today.
text.TL: May ilang proyekto akong inaasikaso ngayon.

text.EN: Just getting things organized around here.
text.TL: Inaayos lang ang mga gamit dito.

text.EN: Keeping my hands moving. Idleness gets people killed.
text.TL: Gumagalaw palagi. Ang kawalan ng gawa ang nagpapahamak sa tao.

text.EN: Keeping busy.
text.TL: Abala ako.

text.EN: Working.
text.TL: Nagtatrabaho.

text.EN: Busy.
text.TL: Abala.

text.EN: Tasks.
text.TL: Mga gawain.

text.EN: Hands full.
text.TL: Maraming hawak.

text.EN: Occupied.
text.TL: May ginagawa.

text.EN: Still on it.
text.TL: Ginagawa pa.

text.EN: No slack.
text.TL: Walang tigil.

text.EN: Chores.
text.TL: Gawain sa kampo.

text.EN: Getting it done.
text.TL: Tinatapos ito.

text.EN: I'm keeping busy and trying to stay useful. There's always something to do.
text.TL: Abala ako at sinusubukan kong maging kapaki-pakinabang. Laging may kailangang gawin.

text.EN: Working hard so our camp stays strong. Glad you stopped by!
text.TL: Nagsusumikap para sa kampo. Masayang dumaan ka!

text.EN: Keeping active, but never too busy for a good word with you.
text.TL: Abala man, hindi mawawalan ng oras para kumustahin ka.

text.EN: Tending to some chores. Nice to take a quick breather with a friend.
text.TL: Gumagawa ng gawain. Masarap magpahinga sandali kasama ang kaibigan.

text.EN: Just doing my part for our little community. How are you doing?
text.TL: Ginagawa lang ang parte ko sa komunidad. Kumusta ka naman?

text.EN: Keeping busy helps keep the worry away. Always good to see you.
text.TL: Nawawala ang kaba kapag may ginagawa. Laging magandang makita ka.

text.EN: Working away! Let me know if you need any help with your own tasks.
text.TL: Nagtatrabaho lang! Sabihan mo ako kung kailangan mo ng tulong sa gawain mo.

text.EN: Plenty of work, but having good folks around makes it easy.
text.TL: Maraming trabaho, pero gumagaan kapag may mabubuting kasama.

text.EN: Just finishing up a few things. It's lovely seeing you today.
text.TL: Tinatapos lang ang ilang bagay. Masarap kang makita ngayong araw.

text.EN: Doing what I can to pitch in. Thank you for checking in on me.
text.TL: Tumutulong sa abot ng makakaya. Salamat sa pangangamusta mo.
